thesis: Ellen Ellison sourced Edenbrook Capital by meeting founder John Brolin at a 2013 Aspen conference and gradually building a relationship over three years, noting his concentrated approach and private-equity-style lens on public markets. The firm was selected because Brolin demonstrated the right temperament for a volatile strategy, remained indifferent to short-term public market sentiment, and maintained deep, constructive relationships with portfolio company management that were confirmed through direct off-reference checks.
